cases.sentence: ___ и два извозчика стояли у крыльца.
cases.translation: The carriage and two cabs stood at the porch.
cases.explain: Карета is the subject of the sentence (стояли), so it is in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: Карета и два извозчика стояли у ___.
cases.translation: The carriage and two cabs stood by the porch.
cases.explain: The preposition у ("by/at") governs the Genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он сделает то, что свойственно его низкому ___.
cases.translation: He will do what is characteristic of his base character.
cases.explain: The predicate свойственно ("characteristic of") governs the Dative case.

cases.sentence: Лакей принес толстый ___, надписанный рукою Алексея Александровича.
cases.translation: The footman brought a thick packet, addressed in Alexei Alexandrovich's hand.
cases.explain: Пакет is the direct object of the transitive verb принес (brought), so it takes the Accusative case.

cases.sentence: Лакей принес толстый пакет, надписанный ___ Алексея Александровича.
cases.translation: The footman brought a thick packet, addressed by Alexei Alexandrovich's own hand.
cases.explain: The Instrumental case expresses the means/agent — "addressed by his own hand."

cases.sentence: Она в ___ души своей уже чувствовала, что она не в силах будет ничего разорвать.
cases.translation: In the depths of her soul she already felt that she would not have the strength to tear anything up.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing a static location ("in the depths") requires the Prepositional case.

reading.ru: По всем комнатам дачного дома ходили дворники, садовники и лакеи, вынося вещи.
reading.question: What is happening throughout the dacha as the passage opens?
options: Servants are packing up and carrying out belongings
A party is being set up
A fire is being put out
reading.correct: Servants are packing up and carrying out belongings
reading.explain: Porters, gardeners, and footmen are going through all the rooms carrying out belongings.

reading.ru: Анна взглянула в окно и увидала у крыльца курьера Алексея Александровича, который звонил у входной двери.
reading.question: Whom does Anna see arriving at the porch?
reading.explain: Anna looks out the window and sees Alexei Alexandrovich's courier ringing at the front door.

reading.question: What was the courier instructed to do?
options: Wait for an answer to bring back
reading.correct: Wait for an answer to bring back
reading.explain: The footman says the courier was ordered to bring back a reply.

reading.ru: Пачка заклеенных в бандерольке неперегнутых ассигнаций выпала из него.
reading.question: What falls out of the envelope along with the letter?
reading.explain: A packet of sealed, uncreased banknotes falls out of the letter.

reading.ru: Когда она кончила, она почувствовала, что ей холодно, и что над ней обрушилось такое страшное несчастье, какого она не ожидала.
reading.question: How does Anna feel after finishing reading the letter?
options: Cold, crushed by an unexpected terrible misfortune
reading.correct: Cold, crushed by an unexpected terrible misfortune
reading.explain: When she finished, she felt cold and that a terrible misfortune she had not expected had fallen on her.

reading.ru: Да, низкий, гадкий человек, и этого никто, кроме меня, не понимает и не поймет.
reading.question: How does Anna privately describe her husband in her thoughts?
options: A low, vile man that only she truly understands
reading.correct: A low, vile man that only she truly understands
reading.explain: She thinks of him as a low, vile man, something no one but she understands.

reading.ru: как он восемь лет душил мою жизнь, душил все, что было во мне живого
reading.question: For how many years does Anna feel her husband has been suffocating her life?
reading.explain: Anna thinks of how he has suffocated her life for eight years, stifling everything alive in her.

reading.ru: «Вы сами можете предположить то, что ожидает вас и вашего сына», — вспомнила она слова из письма.
reading.question: What threatening phrase from the letter does Anna recall?
options: A line implying consequences for her and her son
reading.correct: A line implying consequences for her and her son
reading.explain: She recalls the line from the letter: 'You yourself can guess what awaits you and your son.'

reading.ru: Я разорву эту его паутину лжи, в которой он меня хочет опутать.
reading.question: What does Anna vow to do regarding her husband's "web of lies"?
reading.explain: She vows: 'I will tear through this web of lies with which he wants to entangle me.'

reading.ru: Она села к письменному столу, но вместо того, чтобы писать, сложив руки на стол, положила на них голову и заплакала
reading.question: What does Anna do instead of writing at her desk?
options: She puts her head on her folded arms and weeps
She tears up all her papers
reading.correct: She puts her head on her folded arms and weeps
reading.explain: Instead of writing, she folds her arms on the desk, lays her head on them, and weeps.

reading.ru: Она плакала о том, что мечта ее об уяснении, определении своего положения разрушена навсегда.
reading.question: What does Anna weep over?
options: Her shattered dream of clarifying/resolving her situation
reading.correct: Her shattered dream of clarifying/resolving her situation
reading.explain: She weeps because her dream of clarifying and settling her position is forever destroyed.

reading.ru: Послышавшиеся шаги Лакея заставили ее очнуться.
reading.question: What brings Anna back to herself after she has been crying?
reading.explain: The sound of the footman's approaching steps makes her come to herself.

reading.question: What does the footman report?
options: That the courier is asking for an answer
reading.correct: That the courier is asking for an answer
reading.explain: The footman reports that the courier is asking for a reply.

reading.ru: Она подошла к столу, написала мужу «Я получила ваше письмо, а...» и, позвонив, отдала лакею.
reading.question: What brief reply does Anna begin writing to her husband?
options: Nothing at all — a blank page
reading.explain: She goes to the table and writes to her husband: 'I have received your letter, and...' before handing it to the footman.

reading.ru: «Мы не едем», — сказала она вошедшей Аннушке. «Совсем не едем».
reading.question: What does Anna announce to Annushka?
options: That they are not going after all
That Vronsky is coming to visit
That she is going to bed
reading.correct: That they are not going after all
reading.explain: Anna tells Annushka, who has come in, 'We are not going. Not going at all.'
